resources.string: Health Connect is where health apps on this phone share data. Forkcast can take in your scale\'s weigh-ins, steps and workouts, and send out what you eat and drink.
Fills your weight log and trend. A scale reading replaces a weigh-in you typed within 10 minutes of it.
Shown on Today. Activity above your usual day adds part of it to that day\'s budget.
Each entry as a nutrition record with its meal. Edits and deletions follow.
Health data stays on this phone. Forkcast never sends it to your AI service or anywhere else.
Forkcast also asks to read your past data, so earlier weigh-ins come in, and to read in the background, so it can sync while closed. You can turn off any of these on the next screen.
Health Connect isn\'t available on this phone.
Health Connect needs an update before Forkcast can use it.
Health Connect stopped Forkcast from reading or writing. Check its permissions.
Health Connect asked Forkcast to slow down. It will try again later.
Health Connect isn\'t available right now.
The last sync didn\'t finish. Forkcast will try again.
Syncs about once an hour, even when Forkcast is closed.
Syncs when you open Forkcast. Allow background reads in Health Connect to sync while it\'s closed.
Reads the last 30 days. Allow past data in Health Connect for older weigh-ins.
If nothing opens, Health Connect has stopped asking. Open Health Connect, then App permissions › Forkcast.

Forkcast stops reading and writing, and Health Connect removes its permissions. Food and water already written stay in Health Connect, where you can delete them. Weigh-ins already in your log stay in Forkcast.

Forkcast reads weight, body fat, height, steps, calories burned and workouts from Health Connect to fill your weight log, show your activity, and adjust your calorie budget. It writes your food and water so other apps can see them.

This data stays on your phone. Forkcast has no server, no accounts, no analytics and no ads, and it never sends health data to AI services, food databases or anyone else. Your own backups (files you save, or automatic backups to a folder you choose) can include your weight and activity log.

You can change what Forkcast may read or write at any time in Health Connect, or disconnect in Forkcast's Settings › Health Connect.
